g.title: note1
g.text: • Zero-trust: source code never leaves the machine — only anonymized algorithm telemetry
• Deterministic & offline by default; every LLM path is optional and metadata-only
• Every verdict traceable to a rule id + file/line (audit trail) + CycloneDX CBOM
• Engine degradation is graceful: semgrep → Python ast · Celery → threads · Groq → local rules
